description: The Vera Rubin Observatory has discovered over 11,000 new asteroids within weeks of early observations. The findings highlight its ability to rapidly map the solar system and improve tracking of near-Earth objects for planetary defence.
title: Rubin Observatory Discovers Over 11,000 Asteroids Within Weeks of Imaging

description: Argentine banks are piloting JPMorgan’s JPM Coin to improve interbank settlements and explore blockchain-based financial infrastructure. The initiative focuses on reducing costs and improving transaction speeds while testing distributed ledger technology. The move reflects growing institutional interest in digital assets and could pave the way for wider blockchain adoption in the country’s banking sector.
title: Argentine Banks Reportedly Begin Testing JPMorgan’s JPM Coin for Faster Settlements

description: OnePlus Nord 6 has been launched in India with a  Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 SoC. The new phone comes in three colours and two RAM and storage configurations. It boasts a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with up to 165Hz refresh rate. It carries a 9,000mAh battery with support for 80W wired fast charging and 27W wired reverse charging. It offers IP66 + IP68 + IP69 + IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance.

description: The Vivo X500 series is expected to launch later this year. An early leak suggests that the Vivo X500 Pro Max will come with the Sony LYT-838 sensor, which is likely to be a  50-megapixel, 1/1.28-inch sensor. description: Automatic duplex printing helps save paper and time by enabling double-sided printing without manual effort. description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ are the definition of safe flagships. Both phones offer arguably the best software experience on Android, a build quality that feels premium in every sense, and set a benchmark when it comes to processor architecture. description: The Fujifilm X-T30 III was launched in India on Tuesday. It is positioned as a compact mirrorless digital camera for first-time digital camera users. The latest model in the Japanese camera maker’s X Series combines still photography capabilities with advanced video features, packed in a lightweight body. The Fujifilm X-T30 III is powered by an X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor. The camera offers 4K/60fps video and 1080p recording at up to 240fps for slow-motion capture.
title: Fujifilm XT-30 III Mirrorless Digital Camera Launched in India With X-Trans CMOS 4 Sensor: Price, Features

description: Realme has launched its latest C series handset, dubbed Realme C100 5G, silently. The new smartphone is currently available for pre-order in Thailand via the e-commerce platform Lazada. The handset is offered in Blooming Purple and Sprouting Green (translated from Thai) colour options. The phone is confirmed to go on sale in the country on April 22 in 4GB+128GB and 6GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset powers the Realme C100 5G, coupled with a 7,000mAh battery. It also supports 45W wired fast charging.

description: The Solana Foundation has launched the STRIDE Network to improve security across DeFi protocols. Developed with Asymmetric Research, the framework evaluates projects across multiple risk areas and introduces a real-time incident response network. The move comes amid rising exploit cases, as the industry looks to strengthen transparency, monitoring, and coordinated threat response.
title: Solana Foundation Launches STRIDE Network to Strengthen DeFi Security

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro will be launched in India with Qualcomm’s 4nm octa core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, the Chinese smartphone maker has confirmed. The tech firm updated the dedicated microsite for the phone on Tuesday to reveal the new detail. This also confirms that the Indian version of the Infinix Note 60 Pro will be powered by the same chipset as its global counterpart. Globally, the SoC is claimed to deliver a peak clock speed of 2.7GHz. This comes a day after the company confirmed that the phone will be sold in India in Deep Ocean Blue, Mocha Brown, and Solar Orange colour options.

Branding remains uncertain, and it may either continue the Mix Fold lineup or align with the main number series, while detailed specifications are still unknown.

description: Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G will be launched in India next week, the company announced on Tuesday. description: Bitcoin traded near $68,500 on April 7 after briefly crossing $70,000, with profit booking and geopolitical tensions limiting upside. description: NASA’s Artemis II created history on Monday, as the mission crew completed the lunar flyby. With this, the four astronauts became the first humans to see the far side of the Moon directly. Additionally, the crew also set the record for travelling the farthest distance from the Earth, breaking the previous record, which had remained untouched since 1970.
title: NASA’s Artemis II Mission Completes Lunar Flyby, Sets Farthest Human Spaceflight Record

description: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented by the government in 2017 as a new tax system in the country. GST helps eliminate the chances of the state and the central governments in India levying multiple taxes on the same product multiple times. While you do need GST registration to file returns as a business, you can also easily cancel your registration online through the GST Portal, in case you are no longer liable to pay taxes, closure of business, or discontinuation of business activities.
title: How to Cancel GST Registration Online: Here’s a Step-by-Step Guide
